environment: isolated Work PGlite, disposable users; mocked provider, zero external requests

tests.name: Disabled or incomplete configuration rejects intake without calls or saved jobs
Consent, size, key and workspace permission checks precede transmission
Source-only AI interpretation persists unconfirmed suggestions without creating facts
Successful replay preserves result and rejects same-key changes without new cost/calls
Concurrent retry returns running and only one provider invocation
Confirmed edited information saves provenance and remains idempotent
Invented quotations/numbers and unexpected schema fields fail without publishing facts
Upstream errors and streamed oversized output are sanitized and bounded
Intake and content share budget reservations; over-limit requests call no provider
Monthly reservations and invalid budget settings block intake and text calls
Chat-completions adapter extracts JSON and rejects truncated outputs
Interrupted jobs do not auto-reissue potentially billed requests
Unknown keyword-only fields remain null rather than silently invented
Confirmed AI intake generates a validated AI content version using the same adapter
Per-workspace interpretation rate limit blocks transmission before reservation
AI intake renders with consent, disabled provider and bounded input in all UI languages
